Foundation Panel 的功能更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A feature update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 首页磁贴与网页管理界面完全同步，种类、顺序、尺寸与样式一致。
  The home tiles match the web UI exactly: the same tiles, order, sizes and styles.
- 全新支持时钟模式：大号时钟配常用磁贴，适合放在副屏或平板上常亮。
  New clock mode: a large clock with your everyday tiles, made for a second screen or a tablet.
- 全新支持轮换磁贴：多个磁贴叠成一组，触屏上下滑、滚轮或触控板切换，也会自动轮换。
  New rotating tiles: stack several tiles in one; swipe up and down on touch, or use the wheel or trackpad, and they also rotate on their own.
- 码率、帧率等磁贴提供底部实时走势折线。
  Bitrate, frame rate and similar tiles show a live trend line along the bottom.
- 磁贴可直接操作：主机播放音频、目标码率、停止串流与快捷操作。
  Tiles act directly: host audio playback, target bitrate, stop streaming and quick actions.
- 支持触屏与窄窗口：方形磁贴两列排布，添加与拖动磁贴跟手不误触。
  Touch and narrow windows: square tiles sit two to a row, and adding or dragging a tile follows your finger without stray taps.
- 「帮助与关于」提供软件更新、主机体检、反馈状态与客户端下载磁贴，可在磁贴上直接检查并安装更新。
  Help & About offers tiles for software updates, the host check-up, your feedback status and client downloads; check for and install updates right on the tile.
- 修复拖动磁贴时位置跳动、与相邻磁贴反复换位的问题。
  Fixes a dragged tile jumping and swapping back and forth with its neighbours.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
